deployments_detail.use: GEMS AI, built-in intelligence in its Global Entity Management System that analyzes entity data, surfaces insights, identifies risks and automates tasks

GEMS AI: AI upgrade to the Global Entity Management System that lets clients extract key data from corporate documents, run natural-language queries for real-time compliance insights, review contractual obligations, and draft corporate resolutions from templates. Launched March 2025, available via browser and mobile app. [Computershare (proprietary GEMS platform; underlying LLM undisclosed)]

GEMS AI document-intelligence features in production: AI Translate (automated translation into 50+ languages in seconds), AI Compare (instant version comparison), AI Summarize (AI-generated document summaries), AI Autofill (auto-populate common data fields), AI Document Tag (tag suggestions on upload), and AI Search (natural-language answers across the platform). [Computershare (GEMS platform; model undisclosed)]

AI document processing: automatically identifying and classifying incoming documents to route them to the correct teams, and automating transaction routing based on specified criteria. [Computershare (undisclosed)]

Internal role-based digital assistants ('copilots') and generative-AI process tools used by staff to streamline finance, people management, writing assistance, and meeting-minute generation, automating routine tasks. [Computershare (undisclosed)]

GEMS AI Insights Agent and Custom AI Agents: coordinated agentic AI tasks for risk analysis, data-integrity scanning, and regulatory-impact assessment across entity/compliance data, flagging risks for a strategic compliance overview. [Computershare (GEMS platform)]

AI-powered call-center support: an AI tool that helps customer-service representatives quickly locate answers based on caller needs. Deployed in the US with rollout coming to Canada. [Computershare (undisclosed)]

Investor Center chatbot: a conversational assistant on the shareholder Investor Center / Contact Us pages that answers questions about a shareholder's account and hands off to a live agent when needed. [Computershare (undisclosed)]

Generative-AI content creation and personalization for investor relations, annual reports, and shareholder communications, plus extraction of data from unstructured PDFs/documents to build knowledge assistants combining structured and unstructured data. [Computershare (undisclosed)]
deployments_detail.value: Companies report automating 50-60% of content creation with human oversight (industry figure cited by Computershare)
